While the balance sheet currently shows a positive net worth (equity of $2,520M) and adequate short-term liquidity (current ratio of 1.21), the extremely thin operating profitability and bottom-line losses place the issuer in highly speculative territory. Consequently, the company has high credit risk, justifying a rating in the single-B category.
